login.title: Data Editing System Login
login.label: Login
login.summary: The entry screen where users sign in, request password-reset guidance, or start signup.
purpose: Start a system session with a login ID and password.
Use English before login, then apply the user's configured language after successful login.

layout.name: Login credentials
layout.description: Enter the login ID and password.

layout.name: Target DB area
layout.description: Shows the Target DB context available after login.

layout.name: Support actions
layout.description: Provides forgot-password, signup, and login actions.

workflow: Enter the login ID and password.
Run Login.
After login, the system loads the user language setting and Target DB context.
controls: Forgot password: shows administrator contact and request guidance.
Sign up: opens the new account request flow.
Login: signs in with the entered account.
aiGuidance: Before login, use English as the default screen language.
Do not include passwords, API keys, or other secrets in answers.

home.title: INIT Data Editing System
home.label: Main Home
home.summary: The start screen for checking the current user, role, Target DB, integrated scenario status, notices, and main shortcuts after login.
purpose: Confirm the current session and Target DB context.
Review integrated-flow readiness, recent results, and notices.

layout.name: Session Summary
layout.description: Shows the user, role, Target DB, and current work context.

layout.name: Integrated Scenario
layout.description: Summarizes the editing workflow and KPIs.

layout.name: Notices and Shortcuts
layout.description: Shows notices and links to major work areas.

workflow: Confirm that the intended Target DB is selected.
Review notices and open the required business menu.
controls: Refresh Current Page, Open Integrated Flow, Open All Notices, and Current Menu Help.
aiGuidance: Use the current session, Target DB, dashboard values, and notices when answering HOME questions.

M01001.title: Project Settings
M01001.label: Project Settings
M01001.summary: Registers, reviews, updates, and deletes projects, which are the top-level work units for data editing.
purpose: Manage the project code, name, description, enabled status, and ownership scope.

layout.name: Project List
layout.description: Searches and selects saved projects.

layout.name: Project Detail
layout.description: Creates or edits the selected project.

workflow: Search projects, select an existing row or start a new project, enter required values, and save.
controls: Search, New, Save, and Delete.
aiGuidance: A project is the parent scope for scenarios, target data, and editing work.

M01002.title: Scenario Definition
M01002.label: Scenario Definition
M01002.summary: Defines and manages data editing scenarios under a selected project.
purpose: Manage scenario names, descriptions, enabled status, and their project relationship.

layout.name: Project Selector
layout.description: Selects the parent project.

layout.name: Scenario List and Detail
layout.description: Searches, creates, and edits scenarios.

workflow: Select a project, select or create a scenario, save it, then assign target data in M02002.
controls: Search, Save, Delete, and Delete All for the selected project.
aiGuidance: Explain a scenario as a child work scope under one project.

M02001.title: File Upload Management
M02001.label: File Upload
M02001.summary: Uploads local files into Target DB work tables and supports preview, column review, and data lookup.
purpose: Inspect a local file before creating a Target DB upload table.
Review uploaded columns and data before assigning the table to a scenario.

layout.name: File and Upload Options
layout.description: Selects a file and upload settings.

layout.name: Preview and Table Tree
layout.description: Previews file rows and browses uploaded tables.

layout.name: Columns / Data / SQL
layout.description: Reviews the selected upload table.

workflow: Select a file, preview it, upload it, then review the created table and optionally assign it in M02002.
controls: Preview, Upload, Drop Table, Columns, Data, and SQL.
aiGuidance: Dropping an upload table is destructive and requires the selected table and confirmation.

M02002.title: Target Data Selection
M02002.label: Target Data
M02002.summary: Browses Target DB tables and selects the target tables used by projects and scenarios.
purpose: Inspect Target DB table metadata and sample data.
Register or remove scenario target-table mappings.

layout.name: Table Tree
layout.description: Browses schemas and tables.

layout.name: Table Detail
layout.description: Shows columns and sample data.

layout.name: Scenario Tables
layout.description: Manages tables assigned to the selected scenario.

workflow: Select a project and scenario, inspect a table, then save it as a scenario target table.
controls: Table Tree, Columns, Data, Save Scenario Table, and Delete Mapping.
aiGuidance: Deleting here removes the scenario mapping; do not describe it as dropping the Target DB table.

M03001.title: Column Type Analysis
M03001.label: Column Type Analysis
M03001.summary: Classifies columns as categorical or continuous and compares the run-time classification with the finalized column type used by downstream analysis.
purpose: Create the shared column-type contract for correlation, rule discovery, and violation detection.
Review statistics, missing values, distinct counts, and the reason for each classification.

layout.name: Run-based Column Type
layout.description: The default tab. Shows the classification produced by the selected run.

layout.name: Final Column Type
layout.description: Shows the finalized type that downstream jobs may reuse.

layout.name: Job Parameters
layout.description: Shows the actual saved parameters and result contract for the job.

workflow: Select the scenario and target table.
Choose the integrated profiling procedure or an individual model.
Save and run the job, then review the run-based type before the final type.
aiGuidance: Explain results from the selected run and its actual parameters, not only from preset JSON defaults.
Do not treat a categorical/continuous prediction as a business-approved final type without review.
controls: Project / Scenario / Target Table: selects the shared data-work context.
Save Job / Run: stores the job definition or starts analysis.
Run History / Result tabs: opens run-based and final type details.
Grid tools: server paging, freeze columns, search, refresh, and export.

M03002.title: Column Correlation Analysis
M03002.label: Column Correlation Analysis
M03002.summary: Builds one integrated relationship matrix for categorical-categorical, continuous-continuous, and categorical-continuous pairs, then derives a relationship network and clusters.
purpose: Compare all pair types with the metric appropriate to each data-type combination.
Separate passed and below-threshold pairs while retaining both in the integrated matrix.
Summarize strong relationships as network edges, nodes, and clusters.

layout.name: Integrated Relationship Matrix
layout.description: The default tab. Filters all, passed, or below-threshold pairs and updates pair-type counts together.

layout.name: Categorical Correlation
layout.description: Shows passed categorical-categorical pairs.

layout.name: Continuous Correlation
layout.description: Shows passed continuous-continuous pairs.

layout.name: Relationship Network
layout.description: Combines edge details with node and cluster summaries in one view.

deepDive: PASS_YN distinguishes pairs that passed the actual run thresholds from pairs retained for review.
Clusters are optional guidance for rule discovery and are applied only when P_CLUSTER_USAGE_MODE enables them.
workflow: Select the scenario, target table, and integrated or individual analysis resource.
Save and run the job, then review the integrated matrix, pair-type tabs, and relationship network.
controls: Save Job / Run, Run History, result-tab filters, network controls, grid tools, and export.
aiGuidance: Use the selected Run ID, PASS_YN, pair type, actual thresholds, and cluster method when interpreting results.
The network requires edge data; cluster metadata changes grouping but is not required merely to draw edges.

M03003.title: Automatic Rule Discovery
M03003.label: Automatic Rule Discovery
M03003.summary: Runs categorical Apriori discovery and continuous LASSO plus symbolic formula discovery as one integrated job, while keeping individual models available when needed.
purpose: Discover categorical IF/THEN association rules.
Select important continuous features and generate f(x)=y symbolic rules.
Optionally prefer or restrict candidates by relationship-network cluster.

layout.name: Categorical Automatic Rules
layout.description: Combines the association model and stored rule summary into one readable rule view.

layout.name: Continuous Automatic Rules
layout.description: Compares LASSO feature importance with generated symbolic formulas and target status.

deepDive: P_RULE_PARTS selects ALL, CATEGORICAL, or CONTINUOUS work.
P_CLUSTER_USAGE_MODE supports NONE, PREFER_SAME_CLUSTER, and WITHIN_CLUSTER_ONLY. PREFER_SAME_CLUSTER is the safer default because cross-cluster predictors can remain eligible.
When cluster usage is enabled, a RELATION_NETWORK result from the same run is required.
An important LASSO feature may be absent from symbolic formulas because of R-squared, auto-target range, or feature-selection limits.
troubleshooting: If only categorical results appear, check P_RULE_PARTS, continuous target eligibility, minimum R-squared, auto-target limits, and partial-completion messages.
workflow: Select the scenario, table, and integrated or individual discovery resource.
Save and run the job, then inspect categorical rules and continuous LASSO/symbolic results.
controls: Save Job / Run, Run History, rule-type tabs, detail and graph layers, grid tools, and export.
aiGuidance: Show column labels with IDs and distinguish an association-rule result from a symbolic prediction target.
Explain target counts from the saved run parameters, not only from preset defaults.

M03004.title: Rule Violation Detection
M03004.label: Rule Violation Detection
M03004.summary: Runs categorical association-rule checks and continuous symbolic-formula checks as one integrated job and opens the violating source rows by rule.
purpose: Detect records that contradict categorical condition/result rules.
Detect continuous values outside the configured absolute or percentage error tolerance.

layout.name: Categorical Rule Violations
layout.description: Shows candidate, exception, and violating-row counts for association rules.

layout.name: Continuous Rule Violations
layout.description: Shows predicted/actual values, error measures, and violating rows for symbolic rules.

deepDive: P_RULE_PARTS selects ALL, CATEGORICAL, or CONTINUOUS detection.
P_SYMBOLIC_RULE_TABLE_NAME refers to the symbolic rule storage table, not an association-model name or arbitrary previous result table.
P_RULE_ID=(auto) evaluates all eligible symbolic rules; a specific ID evaluates only that rule.
With P_CONTINUE_ON_ERROR=Y, one subtask may succeed while another fails, so review partial-completion details.
troubleshooting: A successful result with zero rows can mean no violation exceeded the current thresholds; distinguish it from missing rule inputs or a failed subtask.
workflow: Select the scenario, table, and integrated or individual detection resource.
Save and run the job, review rule summaries, then open live or stored violating rows by rule.
controls: Save Job / Run, Run History, rule-part tabs, violation-row detail, grid tools, and export.
aiGuidance: Distinguish association IF/THEN violations from symbolic predicted/actual error violations.
Report partial success and failed subtasks separately when continue-on-error is enabled.

M04001.title: Rule Discovery Execution
M04001.label: Rule Discovery Execution
M04001.summary: Designs, validates, and runs a reusable four-stage DAG from saved data jobs, with artifact compatibility and same-run dependencies enforced at connection time.
purpose: Connect column typing, relationship analysis, rule discovery, and violation detection as one flow.
Use four integrated jobs for the standard path while retaining individual categorical, continuous, LASSO, Apriori, symbolic, and other jobs when needed.

layout.name: Flow Designer
layout.description: Shows representative IN/OUT ports, T for table artifacts, M for model artifacts, and stage-specific connector shapes.

layout.name: Node Inspector
layout.description: Shows the selected node's actual runtime binds, upstream dependency, and result contract.

layout.name: Input and Output Contracts
layout.description: Explains artifact compatibility, REQUIRED/OPTIONAL inputs, SAME_RUN, and solid/dashed execution conditions.

deepDive: Square, triangle, circle, and diamond ports represent stages 1 through 4 respectively.
REQUIRED plus SAME_RUN means the downstream node must receive the compatible result produced earlier in the same flow run.
If P_CLUSTER_USAGE_MODE is not NONE, integrated rule discovery requires the same run's RELATION_NETWORK result.
Port shape compatibility and solid/dashed execution conditions are separate checks and both must pass validation.
troubleshooting: For a rejected connection, compare the output and input artifact names, stage shapes, REQUIRED/OPTIONAL setting, and SAME_RUN policy.
workflow: Select a project, scenario, and saved Flow or create a new one.
Add saved jobs, connect compatible ports, validate and save the DAG, then execute it.
Use Run History for status, node results, retry, and automatic refresh.
controls: Flow Design, Run History, Result SQL, Save Flow, Validate, Run, Refresh, Retry, and node parameter detail.
aiGuidance: Delete Node removes the node from the current draft canvas; it does not directly delete saved jobs or run history.
In editing revalidation mode, saved Flow definitions stay unchanged and only runtime target owner/table parameters are overridden with INITDN$.

M04002.title: Rule Discovery Analysis
M04002.label: Rule Discovery Analysis
M04002.summary: Analyzes a selected flow run through stage-specific integrated result tabs for column types, relationships and clusters, automatic rules, and rule violations.

layout.name: Scenario Runs
layout.description: Selecting a run resets prior node/tab state and builds results for that run.

layout.name: Integrated Results
layout.description: Loads a tab on first use, reuses it within the same run, and preserves vertical scroll while switching tabs.

layout.name: Stage Results
layout.description: Shows integrated matrix/network, categorical/continuous automatic rules, and categorical/continuous violations.

deepDive: The integrated relationship matrix includes PASS_YN=Y and N and supports All, Passed, and Below threshold filters.
The relationship network combines edge and node/cluster information in one screen.
LASSO features are candidates; symbolic formulas are generated rules. The target status is derived from the selected run's actual parameters.
A successful violation task with zero rows is not automatically an error. Check rule counts, thresholds, and partial-completion messages.
troubleshooting: If one categorical or continuous section is missing, check P_RULE_PARTS, upstream same-run inputs, and failed-subtask details.
purpose: Interpret a selected Flow Run without redesigning or rerunning the Flow.
Compare integrated stage results and open model, rule, graph, and violating-row details.
workflow: Select a project, scenario, and Run.
Open stage or node tabs; each tab loads once for the selected Run and preserves its view state.
Use Review Editing Rules to continue with rule decisions when appropriate.
controls: Run selection, stage/node tabs, result filters, detail/graph layers, grid tools, export, and Review Editing Rules.
aiGuidance: Always state the selected Run ID and distinguish baseline runs from INITDN$ editing-revalidation runs.
Result SQL generated from a result table should include available Run ID, table, model, and source conditions but not placeholder literals as data filters.

M05001.title: Editing Rule Management
M05001.label: Rule Decision & Master
M05001.summary: Uses one shared project/scenario scope for a Rule Decision tab that contains discovered results only and a Rule Master tab that manages final selected and user-defined rules.
purpose: Review categorical association rules and continuous symbolic rules from a Flow Run, then select or exclude them.
Validate, create, update, copy, or delete user-defined rules separately from discovered rules.

layout.name: Project / Scenario
layout.description: The collapsible work scope shared by both tabs.

layout.name: Rule Decision
layout.description: Uses server paging and Run source, Run ID, rule type, and decision-status filters for discovered rules.

layout.name: Rule Master
layout.description: Separates selected discovered rules from user rules and provides the user-rule editor below the fixed-height grid.

layout.name: Rule Detail Layer
layout.description: Shows column labels, IF/THEN or f(x), evidence counts, confidence, lift, and prediction target.

workflow: Select a project and scenario, then load the latest Run automatically or enter a Run ID.
Filter and inspect rule details, then select or exclude checked candidates.
Open Rule Master to review final rules or validate and save a user-defined association or formula rule.
controls: Search: applies Run and rule filters through the server query.
Select / Exclude: processes checked discovered rules in bulk with an inline progress bar.
User Rule: validates and creates, updates, copies, or deletes a user-origin rule.
Exclude Selection: excludes checked discovered-origin master rules.
Grid tools: search, refresh, server paging, freeze columns, and export.
aiGuidance: The Rule Decision tab contains discovered results only; user rules are stored and shown only in Rule Master.
Even when All Scenarios is selected, a selected rule is stored with the project and scenario IDs carried by that result row.
Do not describe association IF/THEN rules and continuous f(x)/prediction targets as the same rule format.
A discovered rule is copied to a user rule before editing; it is excluded rather than physically deleted.

M05002.title: Editing Error Correction
M05002.label: Editing Error Correction
M05002.summary: Checks live INITUP$ data with final selected and active rules, edits values only in its one-to-one INITDN$ copy, and keeps correction history in a second cached tab.
purpose: Run live violation SQL generated from final Rule Master rules against the selected INITUP$ table.
Preserve INITUP$ while saving single or multiple corrected values into INITDN$.

layout.name: Editing Work Tables
layout.description: Shows Rule Master INITUP$ tables and their matching INITDN$ tables as a single-select grid.

layout.name: Error Correction
layout.description: Filters live violations by rule type, error column, correction status, and final rule, then edits them in the same grid.

layout.name: Correction History
layout.description: Shows row key, column, before/after values, rule, operator, and edit time for the selected table mapping.

workflow: Select one INITUP$/INITDN$ mapping row.
If INITDN$ does not exist, create the one-to-one editing table from that row.
Run the live violation query and save one row or checked rows into INITDN$.
Use Correction History to review or export the stored cell-edit events.
controls: Create Editing Table: prepares and selects the INITDN$ copy.
Search / Live SQL: executes the live query or displays its read-only SQL.
Save Selected Corrections / Save Correction: validates and stores values in INITDN$.
Rule Detail: combines the M05001 rule detail with the selected violation result.
Grid tools: search, refresh, server paging, freeze columns, and export.
aiGuidance: INITUP$ is never edited by this screen; all corrections are written to INITDN$.
Search executes live SQL against the current table, while Live SQL only displays that statement.
Before INITDN$ exists, the result grid is read-only and edit controls are hidden.
Rows without a business key are linked through the stored INIT$_SOURCE_ROWID value.

M05003.title: Editing Production Deployment
M05003.label: Editing Production Deployment
M05003.summary: Validates editing effects, manages versioned production DML, and reviews the complete editing audit trail in three cached tabs.
purpose: Compare INITUP$ baseline analysis with the linked INITDN$ rule-discovery rerun.
Generate, validate, save, and execute a guarded PL/SQL apply block.
Trace events from rule decisions through final operational apply.

layout.name: Effect Validation
layout.description: Shows changed rows, expected/predicted matches, baseline Run, and INITDN$ reanalysis context.

layout.name: Production Apply
layout.description: Shows DML versions by descending DML ID and an always-editable SQL editor with the selected DML ID.

layout.name: Full History
layout.description: Filters and exports editing audit events for the selected work table.

workflow: Select one INITUP$/INITDN$ work-table row and validate the editing effect.
Create a new DML or regenerate the selected version's initial SQL, then edit its name or SQL if needed.
Validate explicitly or save directly; Save validates first and writes only when valid.
Execute a validated and saved DML, then review the audit event.
controls: Rerun Rule Discovery / Complete Effect Validation: links and validates INITDN$ analysis.
Create New DML: adds a visible New · Unsaved row and server-generated PL/SQL.
Regenerate Initial SQL: resets the selected version to the current editing changes.
Validate DML / Save DML / Execute DML: validate, automatically validate-and-save, or commit the final apply.
Edit / Delete: opens a version in the editor or deletes a non-executed saved DML after confirmation.
Grid tools: DML ID descending order, search, refresh, paging, freeze columns, and export.
aiGuidance: DML execution changes the operational INITUP$ source and commits, so confirm status and affected rows.
Executed DML cannot be deleted or overwritten; an edited copy is saved as a new version after confirmation.
Draft, validated/saved, and failed DML versions update the same DML ID when selected and saved.
New unsaved rows use an amber background; the selected saved row uses a stronger blue background.

M06001.title: Editing Error Correction
M06001.label: Error Correction
M06001.summary: The legacy M06001 route now opens the same shared Error Correction tab and live INITUP$/INITDN$ workflow as M05002.
purpose: Query current INITUP$ violations using final rules.
Correct values in INITDN$ after its one-to-one editing table is prepared.

layout.name: Editing Work Tables
layout.description: Selects one INITUP$/INITDN$ mapping or creates INITDN$.

layout.name: Live Violations and Corrections
layout.description: Pages live violations and saves single or checked corrections.

workflow: Open M05002 or the legacy M06001 route.
Select a source table, prepare INITDN$ if needed, query violations, and save corrections.
controls: Create Editing Table, Search, Live SQL, Save Selected Corrections, Save Correction, and shared grid tools.
aiGuidance: This is an integrated compatibility route, not a planned screen.
INITUP$ is the live query source and INITDN$ is the editable copy.

M06002.title: Editing Error Correction
M06002.label: Correction History
M06002.summary: The legacy M06002 route now opens the same Correction History tab as M05002.
purpose: Review cell-edit events for the selected INITUP$/INITDN$ work table.
Trace row key, column, before/after values, rule, operator, and time.

layout.name: Editing Work Tables
layout.description: Selects the work-table mapping whose history will be queried.

layout.name: Correction History Grid
layout.description: Displays and exports the audit details.

workflow: Select a work table, apply history filters, and review or export the results.
controls: Search, refresh, paging, freeze columns, and export.
aiGuidance: This tab is read-only; corrections are made in the Error Correction tab.
INIT$_SOURCE_ROWID links rows when no business key exists.

M07001.title: Editing Effect Validation
M07001.label: Editing Effect Validation
M07001.summary: The legacy M07001 route now opens the same Effect Validation tab as M05003.
purpose: Compare the INITUP$ baseline Run with the linked INITDN$ rule-discovery rerun.
Review saved changes, expected/predicted matches, and violation changes.

layout.name: Editing Work Tables
layout.description: Selects one work table to validate.

layout.name: Validation Results
layout.description: Shows row-level results and baseline/editing Run context.

workflow: Select a work table, link a rerun, review results, and complete effect validation.
controls: Rerun Rule Discovery, Search, Complete Effect Validation, and export.
aiGuidance: This is an integrated compatibility route, not a planned screen.
Distinguish the baseline Run from the INITDN$ reanalysis Run.

M07002.title: Editing Production Deployment
M07002.label: Production Apply
M07002.summary: The legacy M07002 route now opens the same versioned Production Apply DML tab as M05003.
purpose: Generate and validate guarded PL/SQL from INITDN$ changes.
Save a DML version and commit it to the operational INITUP$ source.

layout.name: DML Version Grid
layout.description: Lists versions by descending DML ID.

layout.name: DML Editor
layout.description: Shows the DML ID, name, status, affected rows, and editable SQL.

workflow: Create or select a DML, validate or save it directly, then execute a validated/saved version.
controls: Create New DML, Regenerate Initial SQL, Validate DML, Save DML, Execute DML, Edit, and Delete.
aiGuidance: Executed DML is immutable audit history and an edited copy becomes a new version.
Execute changes and commits the operational source.

M07003.title: Editing Production Deployment
M07003.label: Full History
M07003.summary: The legacy M07003 route now opens the same Full History audit tab as M05003.
purpose: Trace rule decisions, cell edits, validation, DML save, and DML execution events.
Review operator, time, entity, summary, and detail data.

layout.name: Editing Work Tables
layout.description: Selects the work-table scope.

layout.name: Full History Grid
layout.description: Shows filterable and exportable audit events.

workflow: Select a work table and event type, query history, and open or export details.
controls: Search, refresh, detail, paging, freeze columns, and export.
aiGuidance: This is an integrated compatibility route, not a planned screen.
Answer history questions by work session, operator, time, event type, and entity ID.

M90001.title: Internal Model Registration
M90001.label: Internal Model Registration
M90001.summary: Browses Target DB procedures, packages, and model objects and registers them as executable internal resources without changing object IDs or parameter names.
purpose: Standardize descriptions, result contracts, and defaults for column typing, relationship, rule, and violation procedures.
Expose accurate parameter comments in Data Work and the Flow node inspector.
Manage INIT$_SP_PREDICTED_TYPE model defaults and Target DB-specific overrides from the model resource itself.

layout.name: Object Tree
layout.description: Browses Target DB procedure, package, and model objects.

layout.name: Object Detail
layout.description: Shows registration metadata, parameters, defaults, descriptions, and result contract.

layout.name: Column Type Classification Settings
layout.description: Manages model defaults and Target DB overrides for the column-type procedure.

workflow: Select a Target DB procedure or model object.
Verify that its actual parameter names and types match the preset metadata.
For INIT$_SP_PREDICTED_TYPE, review or edit Target DB overrides in Column Type Classification Settings.
Review the result table/model contract and defaults, then register the resource.
controls: Object search and refresh, Register / Save / Delete, parameter default management, preset overrides, and relationship refresh.
aiGuidance: P_RUN_ID and RUN_SOURCE_TYPE link results from the same Data Work or Flow run.
Deleting a column-type override restores the model default; applying preset overrides may overwrite existing Target DB overrides.
P_SYMBOLIC_RULE_TABLE_NAME identifies symbolic rule storage, not an association model.
For integrated detection, explain P_RULE_PARTS, P_CONTINUE_ON_ERROR, and P_COMMIT_YN together.

M90002.title: External Model Registration
M90002.label: External Model Registration
M90002.summary: Registers built-in Python APIs, external APIs, OML4Py resources, script-repository resources, and their call contracts and default JSON.
purpose: Manage integrated relationship, rule-discovery, and violation-detection APIs together with individual LASSO and symbolic APIs.
Keep method, endpoint, parameter names, types, defaults, descriptions, and result contracts consistent.

layout.name: API Object Groups
layout.description: Lists built-in Python API JSON groups and internal/external API resources.

layout.name: API Object Detail
layout.description: Shows resource type, method, endpoint, description, and invocation metadata.

layout.name: Parameters
layout.description: Shows immutable parameter names with their types, actual defaults, and help comments.

workflow: Select a built-in Python API or an external/OML resource.
Review method, endpoint, output mode, parameters, and default JSON.
Register it, then select the resource in M03001-M03004 Data Work and use the saved job in a Flow.
controls: Group and object search, refresh, load preset JSON, save/register, delete, and parameter input/output editors.
aiGuidance: Preset JSON initializes a new job; explain an executed result from that job's saved parameters and selected run.
When P_CLUSTER_USAGE_MODE is not NONE, the same run's relationship-network input is required.
P_CONTINUE_ON_ERROR=Y may produce a partial integrated result, so report successful and failed subtasks separately.

M90003.title: Model Training Management
M90003.label: Model Training Management
M90003.summary: Manages shared OML model-family training data, candidate training, validation summaries, activation, and rollback as one Target DB workflow. The current column-type family reuses confirmed labels collected across projects.
purpose: Build reusable models from user-confirmed labels collected across projects.
Train and compare candidate models without replacing the production model automatically.
Review detailed type codes together with the final categorical, continuous, and other type groups.

layout.name: Model Family Selector
layout.description: Selects the training family and Target DB, and displays the active physical model name.

layout.name: Overview
layout.description: Summarizes the active model, algorithm, version, quality metrics, and final type-group distribution.

layout.name: Training Data & Label Quality
layout.description: Reviews user-confirmed labels, duplicates, conflicts, and excluded labels.

layout.name: Train & Compare
layout.description: Configures a candidate run and compares its quality with the active model.

layout.name: Model Versions / Run History
layout.description: Reviews candidate, active, and archived versions, activation or rollback, and run history.

workflow: Select a model family and review its active model name and available training labels.

On a fresh installation with no active model or confirmed labels, the M03001 AUTO default completes the first classification with rules. Save reviewed values as user-confirmed labels; after activating a model in M90003, later AUTO runs use both rules and the active model.
Review confirmed labels, duplicates, and conflicts in Training Data & Label Quality.
Configure algorithm, feature version, maximum input rows, and other bounded settings to train a candidate.
After candidate training, the same run automatically records accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1, per-class metrics, group accuracy, and confusion metrics for comparison with the active model.
Activate only a validated candidate; roll back to a previous version when necessary.
Use Run History to review input counts, completion, and errors.
controls: Model family: selects the shared model family to train or compare.
Current Target DB: refreshes model status for the Target DB in the current login session.
Training data search: filters labels by status, final type group, and keywords.
Train candidate: trains a new candidate without changing the production model.
Compare / Activate: compares quality and activates a selected validated version.
Rollback / Archive: restores an earlier version or archives an unused one.
aiGuidance: Only labels explicitly confirmed by users are eligible for training; automatic, migrated, and unconfirmed values are excluded.

The active model name is the physical model recorded in the active-model registry. INIT$_SP_PREDICTED_TYPE reads it directly, so M03001 does not accept a model-name parameter or own a separate training job.
Column-type training uses profile features such as distinct ratio, entropy, data type, nullness, and length; it does not expose original business rows in this screen.
When quality is low or a type group lacks confirmed examples, improve label quality and sample size before training another candidate.

M91001.title: My Account
M91001.label: My Account
M91001.summary: Manages the current user's account information and personal Gemini API key status.
purpose: Review and update the signed-in user's name, email, and password.
Store or delete a personal Gemini API key without exposing the saved secret.

layout.name: Account Information
layout.description: Shows login ID, name, email, and role.

layout.name: Password
layout.description: Changes the password after current-password verification.

layout.name: Personal Gemini Key
layout.description: Shows key registration status and save/delete actions.

workflow: Review account information, change only the required fields, and use the verification flow for sensitive changes.
controls: Save Name / Email / Password, Save Gemini Key, and Delete Gemini Key.
aiGuidance: Passwords and API keys are secrets and must never be repeated in help output or logs.

M91002.title: My System Settings
M91002.label: My System Settings
M91002.summary: Manages user-level UI language and display settings, the system logo, account details, email/password changes, and a personal Gemini API key.
purpose: Manage personal language, display, logo, and account settings by category.
Apply protected account and personal Gemini-key changes through the required verification steps.

layout.name: Setting Categories
layout.description: Lists personal setting groups and values.

layout.name: Setting Detail
layout.description: Edits key, value, description, enabled status, and order. SYSTEM_LANGUAGE provides a language selector.

layout.name: Logo Helper
layout.description: Uploads and previews SYSTEM_LOGO_IMAGE before saving the setting.

layout.name: My Account
layout.description: Manages name, email, password, and personal Gemini key status.

workflow: Select a category and edit or create a setting.
Save a language change, then log out and log in again to apply it.
For a logo, upload the image and then save the setting.
Use the account security checks when changing email or password.
controls: Search Settings, Save Setting, Delete Setting, Create Defaults, Upload Logo, and Account / Gemini actions.
aiGuidance: Passwords and Gemini keys are secrets and must not be repeated in help text, responses, or logs.
A saved language setting may take effect on the next login.

M99001.title: DB Connection Settings
M99001.label: DB Connection Settings
M99001.summary: Lets administrators register and test Target DB connections, inspect or initialize schemas, and deploy model-object groups.
purpose: Manage encrypted Target DB connection profiles and test connectivity.
Inspect or initialize application schemas and deploy PL/SQL model-object groups.

layout.name: Connection List and Detail
layout.description: Manages host, port, service, user, wallet, and profile settings.

layout.name: Schema Status
layout.description: Checks application tables and model-object deployment status.

layout.name: Bootstrap and Deployment
layout.description: Runs explicitly confirmed initialization or group deployment actions.

workflow: Enter and test a connection, save it, inspect schema status, then run only the required initialization or deployment action.
controls: Connection Test, Save Connection, Schema Check / Initialize, Deploy PL/SQL Objects, and confirmed target-data cleanup.
aiGuidance: DB and wallet passwords are secrets managed through server-side encryption and must not be exposed in browser responses or help output.
Administrative authorization is based on the server session and role check, not on whether a menu is visible.
Schema initialization, truncation, and deployment actions require explicit impact review.

M99002.title: Database Management
M99002.label: Database Management
M99002.summary: Lets administrators browse Target DB objects and inspect table data, columns, source, and SQL results.
purpose: Inspect Target DB object metadata, source, columns, and table data.
Run server-validated administrative diagnostic SQL within the permitted scope.

layout.name: Object Tree
layout.description: Browses schemas and database objects.

layout.name: Object Detail / Source
layout.description: Shows metadata and source text.

layout.name: Columns / Data / SQL
layout.description: Inspects table structure, rows, and diagnostic query results.

workflow: Select an object, inspect its details, then run a permitted read-only diagnostic query if needed.
controls: Object Search, Detail, Source, Columns, Data, and SQL Run.
aiGuidance: The regular worksheet path is read-only and the server revalidates the allowed SQL scope.
Do not run data-changing SQL or DDL unless the user explicitly requests an authorized operation.

M99003.title: System Management
M99003.label: System Management
M99003.summary: Supports system initialization checks, system table review, user approval, password reset, and administrator operations.
purpose: Review system initialization and application-table status.
Approve, reset, or deactivate users through server-side administrator authorization.

layout.name: System Status
layout.description: Shows initialization and application-table status.

layout.name: System Tables
layout.description: Inspects permitted system-table columns and data.

layout.name: User Administration
layout.description: Manages approval, password reset, and deactivation.

workflow: Review status first, inspect the required table or user, then confirm the intended administrative action.
controls: Status, Initialize / Truncate, Approve User, Reset Password, and Deactivate.
aiGuidance: Every administrator action requires server-session role validation; hiding or showing the front-end menu is not an authorization boundary.
Treat temporary passwords as secrets and require explicit confirmation for initialization, truncation, or password-reset actions.

M99004.title: Notice Management
M99004.label: Notice Management
M99004.summary: Lets administrators create, update, delete, and attach files to notices shown on the HOME screen and related areas.
purpose: Manage notice content, type, visibility, display period, and attachments.

layout.name: Notice List
layout.description: Searches and selects notices.

layout.name: Notice Detail
layout.description: Edits title, content, type, visibility, and display period.

layout.name: Attachments
layout.description: Uploads, downloads, or deletes notice files.

workflow: Search notices, create or select one, save its display settings, then manage attachments.
controls: Search Notices, Save Notice, Upload Files, Delete Notice, and Delete File.
aiGuidance: Deleting a notice or attachment requires the selected target and confirmation.
